sentences.text: El sábado era el cumpleaños de Marta.

sentences.english: She was going to turn nine.

sentences.text: Marta no sabía nada de la fiesta.
sentences.english: Marta knew nothing about the party.

sentences.text: Rosa y Luis tenían que prepararlo todo.
sentences.english: Rosa and Luis had to get everything ready.

sentences.text: Rosa hizo un pastel de chocolate.
Luis compró globos y los puso en la sala.
sentences.english: Luis bought balloons and put them in the living room.

sentences.text: Pedro acababa de llegar con el regalo cuando Marta entró.
sentences.english: Pedro had just arrived with the present when Marta came in.

sentences.text: Luis le dio un dibujo de Sol.
sentences.english: Luis gave her a drawing of Sol.
"Yes, it is for you," said Luis.

sentences.text: Al final Marta dijo: —¡Gracias a todos, qué día tan bonito!
sentences.english: At the end Marta said, "Thank you, everyone, what a lovely day!"
